title: Acts done by several persons in furtherance of common intention
punishment: Each person is liable for the act in the same manner as if it were done by him alone.

title: Punishments
punishment: Death; Imprisonment for life; Rigorous or Simple Imprisonment; Forfeiture of property; Fine.

title: Act done by a person bound, or by mistake of fact believing himself bound, by law
punishment: No offence (General Exception).

title: Things done in private defence
punishment: Nothing is an offence which is done in the exercise of the right of private defence.

title: When the right of private defence of the body extends to causing death
punishment: Lawful right to cause death in defence against assault causing reasonable apprehension of death, grievous hurt, rape, unnatural lust, kidnapping or abduction, or wrongful confinement.

title: Punishment of criminal conspiracy
punishment: Punished in the same manner as if he had abetted such offence, or rigorous imprisonment up to 6 months or fine or both.

title: Waging, or attempting to wage war, or abetting waging of war, against Bangladesh
punishment: Death, or imprisonment for life, and shall also be liable to fine.

title: Sedition
punishment: Imprisonment for life, to which fine may be added, or imprisonment up to 3 years and fine.

title: Unlawful assembly
punishment: An assembly of five or more persons with common object to overawe Government, resist execution of law, commit mischief or trespass.

title: Punishment for unlawful assembly
punishment: Imprisonment up to 6 months, or fine, or both.

title: Punishment for rioting
punishment: Imprisonment up to 2 years, or fine, or both.

title: Public servant taking gratification other than legal remuneration in respect of an official act (Bribery)
punishment: Imprisonment up to 3 years, or fine, or both.

title: Giving false evidence (Perjury)
punishment: Giving statement which is false and which the person knows or believes to be false.

title: Punishment for false evidence
punishment: Imprisonment up to 7 years and fine (in judicial proceedings); up to 3 years and fine (in other cases).

title: Culpable homicide
punishment: Causing death by doing an act with the intention of causing death, or bodily injury likely to cause death, or knowledge that it is likely to cause death.

title: Murder
punishment: Culpable homicide is murder except in specified exceptions (Grave & Sudden Provocation, Private Defence, Public Servant, Sudden Fight, Consent).

title: Punishment for murder
punishment: Death, or imprisonment for life, and shall also be liable to fine.

title: Punishment for culpable homicide not amounting to murder
punishment: Imprisonment for life, or imprisonment up to 10 years, and fine.

title: Causing death by negligence
punishment: Imprisonment up to 5 years, or fine, or both.

title: Attempt to murder
punishment: Imprisonment up to 10 years and fine; if hurt is caused, imprisonment for life or up to 10 years.

title: Hurt
punishment: Whoever causes bodily pain, disease or infirmity to any person.

title: Grievous hurt
punishment: Emasculation; Permanent privation of sight; Permanent privation of hearing; Privation of member or joint; Destruction of powers of joint; Permanent disfiguration of head or face; Fracture or dislocation of bone; Hurt endangering life for 20 days.

title: Punishment for voluntarily causing hurt
punishment: Imprisonment up to 1 year, or fine up to 1,000 Taka, or both.

title: Punishment for voluntarily causing grievous hurt
punishment: Imprisonment up to 7 years, and shall also be liable to fine.

title: Voluntarily causing grievous hurt by dangerous weapons or means
punishment: Imprisonment for life, or imprisonment up to 10 years, and fine.

title: Assault or criminal force to woman with intent to outrage her modesty
punishment: Imprisonment up to 2 years, or fine, or both.

title: Punishment for kidnapping
punishment: Imprisonment up to 7 years, and shall also be liable to fine.

title: Rape (Definition)
punishment: Sexual intercourse with a woman against her will, without her consent, with consent obtained by putting in fear of death or hurt, with consent by impersonation, or with or without consent when she is under fourteen years of age.

title: Punishment for rape
punishment: Imprisonment for life or imprisonment up to 10 years, and fine (Death penalty amended under Women and Children Repression Prevention Act).

title: Theft (Definition)
punishment: Intending to take dishonestly any movable property out of the possession of any person without that person's consent.

title: Punishment for theft
punishment: Imprisonment up to 3 years, or fine, or both.

title: Extortion (চাঁদাবাজি)
punishment: Intentionally putting any person in fear of injury and dishonestly inducing the person to deliver property.

title: Punishment for extortion
punishment: Imprisonment up to 3 years, or fine, or both.

title: Robbery (ডাকাতি / দস্যুতা)
punishment: In all robbery there is either theft or extortion, with causing or attempting to cause death, hurt, or wrongful restraint.

title: Dacoity
punishment: When five or more persons conjointly commit or attempt to commit a robbery.

title: Punishment for dacoity
punishment: Imprisonment for life, or rigorous imprisonment up to 10 years, and fine.

title: Dishonest misappropriation of property
punishment: Imprisonment up to 2 years, or fine, or both.

title: Criminal breach of trust (আমানত খেয়ানত)
punishment: Being entrusted with property and dishonestly misappropriating or converting it to own use.

title: Punishment for criminal breach of trust
punishment: Imprisonment up to 3 years, or fine, or both.

title: Criminal breach of trust by public servant, banker, merchant or agent
punishment: Imprisonment for life, or imprisonment up to 10 years, and fine.

title: Cheating (প্রতারণা)
punishment: Deceiving any person fraudulently or dishonestly to deliver any property.

title: Cheating and dishonestly inducing delivery of property (Section 420)
punishment: Imprisonment up to 7 years, and shall also be liable to fine.

title: Criminal trespass
punishment: Entering into property in possession of another with intent to commit an offence.

title: Forgery (জালিয়াতি)
punishment: Making any false document with intent to cause damage or injury, or support any claim or title.

title: Forgery for purpose of cheating
punishment: Imprisonment up to 7 years, and shall also be liable to fine.

title: Defamation (মানহানি)
punishment: Making or publishing any imputation concerning any person intending to harm the reputation of such person.

title: Punishment for defamation
punishment: Simple imprisonment up to 2 years, or fine, or both.

title: Punishment for criminal intimidation (হুমকি প্রদান)
punishment: Imprisonment up to 2 years, or fine, or both; if threat be to cause death or grievous hurt, imprisonment up to 7 years.

title: Punishment for attempting to commit offences
punishment: Imprisonment for a term which may extend to one-half of the longest term provided for that offence, or fine, or both.
